correctness.rationale: PASS: The implication for arbitrary upsets was reconstructed from its successor-set definition; injectivity is necessary by transposition, with an additional single-top colour-collapse argument. A proper nonempty upper generator defines the middle upset when \(b\ge2\); otherwise the upper-one generator meet defines it. Relative Heyting complements generate the upper and lower Boolean intervals. Column decomposition and partition-lattice Möbius inversion prove both enumerators; counting universal-one columns gives the sharp rank. Full-operation closure independently agrees with the structural criterion and formula for 4,052 tested tuples. Finite tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: PASS: Enumeration of generating families for a natural finite algebraic semantics (ordinal sums of antichains) yields an explicit exact k-tuple polynomial, a phase boundary at a singleton top level, and a sharp logarithmic rank for arbitrary two level widths. These are structural data of the algebra itself, beyond a simple instance of the qualitative finite-colouring theorem. They can support studies of random or minimal generation without claiming an unproved downstream theorem.
